title: UltraBERT-JEV: Encoder models for System One Applications
abstract: arXiv:2611.17867v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study encoder models that pick one of several options in a single forward pass, without generating text. This technical report compares recipes for fine-tuning UltraBERT-380M with one mask per option. The four recipes differ in how an option is scored and how the scores become probabilities; one follows the expert gate of DeepSeek-V3. Trained on the same data as Qwen3-0.6B with the LLM-as-Jev recipe (67.6% test accuracy), the encoder reaches 69.7% to 72.1%. Scoring an option by "yes" minus "no" instead of "yes" alone gives the larger gain, from 69.7% to 71.3% on the test set and from 57.8% to 59.6% on external benchmarks (56.1% for the decoder). Sigmoid normalisation adds 0.8 test points; a square-root softplus adds none. One request at a time on an NVIDIA A100, the encoder takes 29 ms per decision against 68 ms, but uses more peak memory (2.8 against 2.2 GiB). translated_title: UltraBERT-JEV：面向“系统一”应用的编码器模型
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一种编码器模型，它可以在单次前向传播中从多个选项中直接挑选一个，而无需生成文本。本技术报告比较了微调 UltraBERT-380M（每个选项对应一个掩码）的几种方案。这四种方案的区别在于如何对选项打分以及如何将分数转换为概率，其中一种借鉴了 DeepSeek-V3 的专家门控机制。在与 Qwen3-0.6B 使用相同数据训练的情况下，采用 LLM-as-Jev 方案的解码器测试准确率为 67.6%，而编码器模型达到了 69.7% 至 72.1%。用“是”减“否”（而非仅用“是”）来为选项打分带来了更大的提升：测试集上从 69.7% 提升至 71.3%，外部基准上从 57.8% 提升至 59.6%（解码器为 56.1%）。Sigmoid 归一化额外带来 0.8 个测试点的提升，而平方根 softplus 则没有带来提升。在 NVIDIA A100 上单次处理一个请求时，编码器每次决策仅需 29 毫秒（解码器为 68 毫秒），但峰值内存占用更高（2.8 GiB 对比 2.2 GiB）。一个在人工标注证据和标签上训练的辅助头……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出UltraBERT-JEV编码器模型，通过单次前向传播直接从多个选项中选择答案而无需生成文本，配合“是-否”差值打分等微调方案，准确率最高达72.1%并超越同数据训练的0.6B解码器模型，同时推理速度快一倍以上（29毫秒对比68毫秒）。
en_tdlr: UltraBERT-JEV encoder models pick one of several options in a single forward pass without generating text, reaching up to 72.1% accuracy to surpass the Qwen3-0.6B decoder trained on the same data, while making decisions more than twice as fast (29ms vs 68ms), with "yes" minus "no" scoring as the most impactful fine-tuning recipe.
